Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

The Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Product Team at Commure + Athelas powers the core operating system for our practices. Our product, Insights, provides practice staff and administrators with everything they need to manage their practice’s operations efficiently. We maintain 150+ customer-facing features, ranging from high-level reports and visualizations to workflow automation tools to help the staff boost their practice’s revenue.

This role will play a key role in scaling and maintaining our website’s infrastructure, ensuring a seamless user experience as we grow to support thousands of practices nationwide.

jobs.description:
Full-stack Software Engineer (Mid-level) · €40k–50k/year, contractor

➡️ THE ROLE

We are looking for a full-stack engineer with 4+ years of experience who wants to grow into a senior role with us. You will join a small team and work across the stack, from our web apps to our AI services, with room to take on more ownership as you grow.

➡️ WHAT YOU BRING

Technical
• 4+ years shipping production TypeScript on Node. You're comfortable with strict types, async code, and reading a codebase you did not write.
• Working React experience: you can build and debug a form, a data table and a query-backed screen without hand-holding.
• You've debugged production issues end to end: logs, reproduction, root cause, fix, test, deploy.
• You write tests as part of the change, not after.
• Solid fundamentals in relational SQL, Git with clean PRs, and Docker for running a local stack.

Who you are
• You take initiative: if something is broken or missing, you pick it up.
• You work autonomously from a goal, not a detailed spec, and know when to ask.
• You see your work through to production.
• You keep the team updated and raise problems early.
• You ask for and give review, kindly and precisely, and take feedback without defensiveness.
• You are eager to learn an unfamiliar domain (LCA) and, if needed, a new language on the job.
• You have working English, written and spoken. You write clear tickets, PR descriptions and short docs.

Working with AI
• You already use an AI coding assistant daily and can explain, with examples, when it was wrong and how you caught it.
• You read generated code before accepting it and treat AI output as a draft, not as truth.

➡️ NICE TO HAVE

• Python in production
• LLM application work (tool calling, structured output, evals)
• Message queues
• Playwright
• Security awareness
• Data-heavy work
• Any exposure to LCA and sustainability data

None of these are blockers.

➡️ HOW WE WORK

We build and review with AI in the loop, and the engineer stays accountable for every line that ships. AI drafts, and you read it, run it and sign off. Reviews are specific, kind and about the code.

➡️ TERMS

• Budget: €40k to €50k per year, depending on experience.
• Full-time, long-term engagement. We are looking for someone who makes this their main focus, not a side project.
• Mostly remote, with São Paulo preferred for occasional in-person meetings.
• Working English is required.

➡️ HOW TO APPLY

Email engineering_jobs@livecycle.ai with the subject "[Full-stack Engineer] Your Full Name" and include:

1. Your CV as a PDF. Well structured and easy to scan, showing what you built and what you owned.
2. A cover letter, in the email body or as a PDF. Tell us what you understand about what LiveCycle does, and, given your experience, what makes you stand out for this role.
3. Brief answers to these questions:
 • What is your strongest TypeScript/Node project?
 • Tell us about a time an AI assistant was wrong. How did you catch it?
 • What's something you changed your mind about in the last year, technical or not?
 • Your LinkedIn and/or GitHub link.

➡️ PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

We expect a high volume of applications, from people and from automated agents, so we hold a high bar and apply it consistently:

• Applications without a cover letter will not be considered.
• You're welcome to use AI to help you write, as we do every day. But a generic letter that could have been sent to any company, or that doesn't show you understand what we do and why you're a strong fit, will not move forward.
• We only review applications sent by email. Applications submitted through LinkedIn will not be reviewed.
** Candidates messaging the team members directly will be rejected, so please follow the application guidelines **

Taking the time to follow these steps carefully is part of the process. If that feels like too much effort, this role is probably not the right fit, and that's completely fine.
